_note: Sahra Trail size charts (10 Nov 2026). Source: claude/HANDOFF-Trail-Tee-and-Short-size-charts-for-website-10-Nov-2026.md. Tee: master size chart v3.5, sheet 6 (23 Sep). Short: Supplier Pack v1.4, page 5 (9 Oct), which matches master v3.5 sheet 7. These are the finished garment measurements the supplier was given (the contract figures), in cm; inches are derived and rounded to a quarter inch. No washed bulk set has been measured yet; Faheem decided on 10 Nov to publish the supplier spec now. When a washed set is measured, check it against these and update any point that is out by more than the tolerance. Only the customer-facing rows are here: the internal points (across back, neck, vents, mesh width, back rise, liner leg opening, pocket sizes) stay off the site. body = the shared UAE bands from the Sizing Rule (master sheet 1); the whole-inch figures are those bands rounded. S to XL only (no XXL). No fabric weight and no performance claims in this copy.

tee.label: Sahra Trail Tee
tee.intent: Raglan sleeves to mid-bicep and a straight hem, in a relaxed athletic fit. It is not a compression fit.
tee.note: The sleeve is measured from the neck to the cuff, because a raglan sleeve has no shoulder seam. It reads longer than the sleeve on a regular tee, but it ends at mid-bicep.
method: Chest: garment laid flat, measured straight across 2.5 cm below the armhole. Double it for the full chest.
Length: from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem.
Sleeve: from the neck point to the cuff.
tee.flat: Measured flat, so the chest is half the way round. Double it to compare with your own.

short.label: Sahra Trail 2-in-1 Short
short.intent: The outer short has an 18 cm (7″) inseam, and the hidden liner sits 6 cm shorter. The waistband is elastic, with a drawcord inside.
method: Waist: the waistband laid flat, measured straight across, once relaxed and once fully stretched. Double it for the full waist.
Hip: laid flat, measured straight across 2.5 cm below the crotch.
Inseam: from the crotch seam down to the hem of the outer short.
short.flat: Measured flat, so the waist and hip are half the way round. Double them to compare with your own.

how.tee: Measure your chest at its fullest point, with the tape level and snug. Height is a guide only.
how.short: Measure your waist where the waistband sits, with the tape level and snug. Height is a guide only.
how.both: Measure your chest at its fullest point and your waist where the waistband sits, with the tape level and snug. Height is a guide only.

own: Its sizes do not carry over from our Founding Edition or Sahel tees.
tolerance: These are the finished measurements each piece is made to. Allow ±1 cm.
